title: Bhagat Singh
summary: Born in 1907 in Banga village, Lyallpur district, he belonged to the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association. After the death of Lala Lajpat Rai in Lahore in November 1928, police officer J. P. Saunders was killed in error for J. A. Scott. Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt threw bombs in the Central Legislative Assembly on 8 April 1929. A special tribunal sentenced him to death, and he was hanged at Lahore Jail on 23 March 1931, aged 23.

uncertainty.note: Birth and hanging dates are stated by the sources; the Saunders killing is dated only as after November 1928 by Encyclopedia.com.

where.modern_name: Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan (pinned to the city of the Saunders killing, the tribunal and the hanging; city centroid. The Assembly bombing was in Delhi and his birthplace Banga is near Faisalabad)

importance.justification: Revolutionary executed in 1931 who remains a prominent figure of the Indian independence struggle.

sources.title: Bhagat Singh trial case file exhibition

reviewer_note: The Dawn article dates the Saunders killing to December 1929, which conflicts with Encyclopedia.com (after November 1928); the summary follows Encyclopedia.com and gives no exact day. Views of his methods differ and are not assessed here. Pin is the Lahore city centroid.
